title: Inclusion graph of annihilators in a commutative ring
summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring with identity, and let $Z(R)$ be the set of zero-divisors of $R$. The inclusion graph of annihilators in $R$, denoted by $Γ^{\prime}(R)$, is a graph with the vertex set $Z(R)^*=Z(R)\setminus\{0\}$ and two distinct vertices $x$ and $y$ are adjacent if and only if $\operatorname{ann}_R(x)\subseteq \operatorname{ann}_R(y)$ or $\operatorname{ann}_R(y)\subseteq \operatorname{ann}_R(x)$.
